note: What a server sends to show text floating over a unit. The header names the unit.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Where the text goes. 0 floats it over the unit while the unit is in the client's own view. 1 to 50 writes it, in colour, to that line of a debugging display, only where the unit is the player's own. A client does nothing for any other value.

fields.name: error
fields.note: Nonzero has a client show the text as an error message for ten seconds, wherever slot points.

fields.name: colour
fields.note: The text's colour on the debugging display; it has no effect for slot 0.

fields.name: text
fields.note: The text, ended by a zero byte.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Where the text goes. 0 floats it over the unit while the unit is in the client's own view, the text looked up as a key into the client's own text. 1 to 50 writes it, in colour, to that line of a debugging display, only where the unit is the one the player has selected. A client does nothing for any other value.

fields.name: error
fields.note: Nonzero has a client ignore the whole message.

fields.name: colour
fields.note: The text's colour on the debugging display; it has no effect for slot 0.

fields.name: length
fields.note: The text's length in bytes, counting its zero byte.
